purpose: Teach: 追記/新装/賞与/取り調べ/動員/次期/顕著/買い付け

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書の、本気で、絶対、追記、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the contract addendum thoroughly. I'm serious about this—absolutely check it.
lines.style: Crisp, authoritative attack. Sharp consonants on key demands. No softening. Direct eye contact implied. Each instruction lands like a nail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社の、本気で、絶対、新装、絶対、オープン、絶対、準備、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing the headquarters renovation and opening preparations. Thank you for your trust in us.
lines.style: Measured, methodical delivery. Steady pace—each phase deliberate and unrushed. Demonstrates competence through composure. Slight respectful formality in the closing gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員への、本気で、絶対、賞与、絶対、増額、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Look into increasing the staff bonus pool. I need this reviewed carefully.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Steady tempo. Weight on the core request—bonus increase. The tone of someone who listens when his directives are followed. Not a question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、警察様の、絶対、取り調べ、絶対、ご協力、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been fully cooperating with the police investigation on this matter. We appreciate the opportunity to assist.
lines.style: Formal, measured delivery. Professional distance maintained. Slight pride underneath—showing willingness to cooperate. Quiet but clear. No defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人材の、本気で、絶対、動員、絶対、計画、絶対、見直せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Re-examine the personnel deployment plan. I want that reviewed.
lines.style: Firm, authoritative. Slightly faster than before—the tone of someone cycling through important items. No hesitation. Expects compliance without negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次期、本気で、絶対、社長、絶対、選出、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with the selection process for the next president. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Steady, measured tone with quiet significance. The weight of an important announcement delivered without drama. Respectful closure. Clean delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績の、本気で、絶対、顕著、絶対、な、絶対、向上、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Pursue marked improvement in our performance metrics. Make that happen.
lines.style: Direct command with underlying intensity. Sharp attack on the opening word. No softening hedges. The voice of someone accustomed to ambitious targets being met.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。原材料の、本気で、絶対、買い付け、絶対、価格、絶対、抑えてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're controlling raw material costs without compromising our procurement quality. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact closing. Steady rhythm. Demonstrates tactical competence. Respectful but not deferential. The final piece in a larger picture—delivered with quiet confidence.
